name: Speak with Un'thuwa
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Un'thuwa, tribal mage of Sen'jin Village, detects a disturbance in the magic currents of Durotar and asks for aid.  Speak with Un'thuwa and do what you can to help him.

Do this, and in time further secrets will be revealed to you.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hail, adventurer. Praise to you, for my call for aid is now answered. Let us hope you are up to the task...

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 10, 935 XP in all.

quests.name: Ju-Ju Heaps
quests.objectiveText: Destroy 4 Ju-Ju Heaps, then return to Un'thuwa in Sen'jin Village.
